title: Shrimp and Avocado Salad with Russian Vinaigrette
description:
Last Edit Date: 4/10/2015 1:19:27 PM
There are worse things in the world than having leftover Russian dressing from our Kimchi Reuben recipe. You can spread it on burgers, drizzle it over steamed mussels, or turn it into a sprightly viniagrette for this salad. You can cook the shrimp however you like, either poaching or grilling or roasting them.
ingredients: 1 head Bibb lettuce, torn into leaves
directions: In a small bowl, whisk the Russian dressing with the lemon juice, olive oil, and a few grinds black pepper.

Divide the avocado among 4 serving plates. In a large bowl, combine the lettuce leaves with the grapes, snap peas, onion, and dill. Divide among the four plates, arrange the shrimp on top, drizzle with the dressing, and serve garnished with pea shoots.
1/4 tsp. Sriracha or other hot sauce
In a small bowl, combine the dressing ingredients. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week.
